A great quick weeknight dinner is **One-Pan Lemon Garlic Chicken with Asparagus & Potatoes**:  
- Toss chicken thighs, halved baby potatoes, and asparagus with olive oil, minced garlic, lemon zest, lemon juice, salt, pepper, and dried oregano.  
- Roast at 425 °F (220 °C) for 25–30 min until chicken hits 165 °F and veggies are tender.  
- Finish with a pat of butter and fresh parsley. Serve with crusty bread.
